# Song of Solomon Chapter 3 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**3:1** On my-bed [al mishkavi] in-the-nights [ba-leilot] I-sought [biqqashti] him-whom [et she-] my-soul [nafshi] loves [ahavah]; I-sought-him [biqqashtiv] and-I-did-not-find-him [ve-lo metzativ].

**3:2** I-will-arise [aqumah] now [na] and-I-will-go-about [va-asovevah] in-the-city [ba-ir], in-the-streets [ba-shuqim] and-in-the-squares [u-va-rechovot]; I-will-seek [avaqshah] him-whom [et she-] my-soul [nafshi] loves [ahavah]. I-sought-him [biqqashtiv] and-I-did-not-find-him [ve-lo metzativ].

**3:3** The-watchmen [ha-shomrim] who-go-about [ha-sovevim] in-the-city [ba-ir] found-me [metza'uni]: "Him-whom [et she-] my-soul [nafshi] loves [ahavah] — have-you-seen [ra'item]?"

**3:4** Scarcely [ki-me'at] had-I-passed [she-avarti] from-them [me-hem] when [ad she-] I-found [matzati] him-whom [et she-] my-soul [nafshi] loves [ahavah]. I-seized-him [achazitiv] and-would-not [ve-lo] let-him-go [arpennu], until [ad she-] I-brought-him [havi'otiv] to the-house [el beit] of-my-mother [immi] and-to the-chamber [ve-el cheder] of-her-who-conceived-me [horati].

**3:5** I-adjure-you [hishba'ti etkhem], daughters [benot] of-Jerusalem [Yerushalayim], by-the-gazelles [bi-tzeva'ot] or by-the-does [o be-aylot] of-the-field [ha-sadeh]: do-not-stir [im ta'iru] and-do-not-awaken [ve-im te'oreru] love [et ha-ahavah] until [ad] she-pleases [she-techpatz].

**3:6** Who [mi] [is] this [zot] coming-up [olah] from the-wilderness [min ha-midbar] like-columns [ke-timrot] of-smoke [ashan], perfumed [mequtteret] with-myrrh [mor] and-frankincense [u-levonah], from-all [mi-kol] the-powders [avqat] of-the-trader [rokhel]?

**3:7** Behold [hinneh], the-bed [mittato] of-Solomon [she-li-Shlomo]; sixty [shishim] warriors [gibborim] [are] around-it [saviv lah], from-the-warriors [mi-gibborei] of-Israel [Yisra'el].

**3:8** All-of-them [kullam] holders [achuzei] of-sword [cherev], trained [melummedei] in-war [milchamah]; each-man [ish], his-sword [charbo] on his-thigh [al yerekho], against-terror [mi-pachad] in-the-nights [ba-leilot].

**3:9** A-palanquin [appiryon] King [ha-melekh] Solomon [Shlomo] made [asah] for-himself [lo] from-the-trees [me-atzei] of-Lebanon [ha-Levanon].

**3:10** Its-pillars [ammudav] he-made [asah] of-silver [kesef], its-back [refidato] of-gold [zahav], its-seat [merkavo] of-purple [argaman]; its-interior [tokho] [was] inlaid [ratzuf] with-love [ahavah] by-the-daughters [mi-benot] of-Jerusalem [Yerushalayim].

**3:11** Go-out [tze'enah] and-look [u-re'enah], daughters [benot] of-Zion [Tziyyon], on King [ba-melekh] Solomon [Shlomo], with-the-crown [ba-atarah] that his-mother [she-itterah lo immo] crowned-him on-the-day [be-yom] of-his-wedding [chatunnato] and-on-the-day [u-ve-yom] of-the-joy [simchat] of-his-heart [libbo].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "on my bed in the nights":** The plural "nights" (*ba-leilot*) suggests repeated searching, not a single night. This is a dream-sequence or recurring longing.

**v.6 — "columns of smoke":** The word *timrot* (columns) appears only here and in Joel 3:3. The image is of a desert procession marked by rising incense smoke — a transition from the private love poetry to the public wedding spectacle.

**v.9 — "palanquin" (appiryon):** A hapax legomenon (appears only here in the Hebrew Bible). Possibly derived from Greek *phoreion* or Sanskrit *paryanka*. It refers to an enclosed litter or sedan chair for royal transport.

*-- EMET*
